rules.text: Provenance exists for every evidence-bearing claim.
A declared source resolves inside the product/transformation evidence records.
Every claim carries a canonical claim label.
A claim labelled sourced_evidence/expert_reviewed names its source.
Claim strength must not exceed evidence strength: sourced/expert labels may not rest on hypothesis-only material.
A hypothesis or model inference must never be presented as established fact.
Numeric/statistical claims must be carried by a sourced/expert-labelled claim in the cited truth.
Causal/efficacy claims must be supported at the label the applicable Domain Authority Pack allows; efficacy is never asserted from a hypothesis.
Source class must be permitted by the applicable Domain Authority Pack.
Market-sensitive/dated claims must carry a date/context where the pack requires it.
Population/jurisdiction applicability must be preserved, not universalized, where the pack requires it.
Claim-to-source semantic entailment where a model judgment is genuinely required.
The applicable Domain Authority Pack must exist and authorize the claim classes used.

automatic_authorization_conditions: every claim has a canonical label
sourced/expert claims name a resolvable source
no claim strength exceeds its evidence strength
hypotheses are not presented as fact
numeric/causal/efficacy claims are carried by cited truth at the permitted strength
an ACTIVE, applicable Domain Authority Pack resolves
automatic_rejection_conditions: a required source is missing or unresolved
a claim exceeds its evidence strength
a hypothesis is presented as fact
no applicable ACTIVE Domain Authority Pack exists
the pack does not authorize a claim class that is present

provenance.note: Machine-readable encoding of the EXISTING Gate-4 evidence standard. It strengthens rather than weakens evidence requirements; no threshold is lowered.
